title: Health claims lead (f/m/x)
description: Intro As our Health Claims lead, you'll own claims decisions on Feather's health MGA books from day one: coverage, declines, settlement amounts, all within policy terms. You'll manage our insurance carrier relationships, decide how we work with service providers, and build the playbook, automations and systems that let the function scale as we grow MGA health claims fast across expat and international health. At Feather, we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer. Why work at Feather? We're small, lean, and we love what we do. The usual buzzwords here, except we actually mean them. Staying small helps us focus on what matters, and we want to keep it that way. You'll work on a product that is loved by customers. Our excellent Trustpilot and Google reviews speak for themselves. There's plenty of space to grow. We trust you to take ownership and make real decisions from day one, and you'll have all the support you need to succeed. You'll have the freedom to build something from scratch. You're not inheriting a finished system. You're building the decision logic, reporting, and playbook that let health claims scale. Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment, hiring across Europe via an Employer of Record . We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together. What you bring to the table You have hands-on experience handling health claims across borders or internationally. You are familiar with medical coding and provider billing. You have an instinct for automation and AI tooling, and you use it daily. You take tough decisions daily, including saying no to customers, and you still enjoy the work. You are pragmatic in an unfinished system: you improve it while running it. You are a fluent English speaker. Nice to have: German, Spanish, or French language skills. Experience with moratorium underwriting. A medical background. Experience in an MGA or delegated authority setup. Experience managing third-party administrators (TPAs). You'll be responsible for You will make claims decisions You will interpret coverage, decide declines, settlement amounts, and goodwill within policy terms, with real authority, not recommend-and-wait. You will handle expat and international health claims: cross-border invoices across languages and billing conventions, currency and tax, and coordination with statutory and private cover in the country of residence. You will manage our carrier relationships You will own claims reporting and bordereaux, contentious cases, and coverage disputes with our insurance partners. You will keep audit-ready records throughout, so nothing surprises the carrier. You will decide how we work with service providers You will decide where using third-party administrators (TPAs) makes sense, and manage instructions, quality, turnaround, and commercial performance where we use them. You will build the operating model You will close gaps with product and engineering across intake, documents, decision support, payout, and automation. You will run audits and fraud checks, working toward semi-automated monitoring with the data team. You will build capability You will write the playbook so health claims stops depending on one person. You will train whoever joins the team next. What will the interview process look like? CV screening Initial phone call with our People team. We'll have a chat and get to know each other (30m) Hiring manager call. We'll cover the role, skills needed, and answer your questions (1 hour) Case study. We'll give you a case study to work on, which will give you an idea of the type of projects you'd take on at Feather (3-4h) Case study discussion. We'll go through your reasoning and approach together (90min) Call with our Head of Ops. We'll talk through our async, remote-first way of working and how our team operates day to day (45min) Final interview. You'll be speaking to one member of our leadership team (45min) Does this sound like a good fit for you? Apply now! At Feather, we actively foster inclusive representation within our teams and embrace a diverse mix of talent. We encourage applicants from all educational paths to apply: we believe that what you’ve built, worked on, and achieved is far more important than on-paper qualifications. Develop and expand upon the job family, CDF, and long-term hiring and growth objectives for the Technical Program Management function.</li> <li>Build strong relationships  with cross-functional stakeholders including Engineering, Product, Security, and GTM teams.</li> <li>Identify and mitigate risks, resolve conflicts, and remove obstacles for the Technical Program Management team to ensure timely program delivery.</li> <li>Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for programs and team members and hold the team accountable for meeting commitments.</li> <li>Lead strategic planning with direct influence over staffing decisions, project timelines, and planning stakeholders.</li> <li>Demonstrate leadership as expected of Managers across GitLab and Embody our<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/values/#:~:text=values%20at%20GitLab-,CREDIT,other%20by%20assuming%20good%20intent."> CREDIT values</a> in your work</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience as a people manager and as an IC TPM, ideally in a position of seniority</li> <li>Ability to prioritize and delegate work effectively</li> <li>Proven track record of successful collaboration with internal and external stakeholders</li> <li>Experience developing and executing on strategic team development plans </li> <li>Ability to coach others on driving cross functional product-driven initiatives, without direct control of the programs</li> <li>Proven ability to position oneself and the team as trusted partners and thought leaders</li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/job-families/engineering/technical-program-management/#senior-manager-technical-program-management">More information about the Sr Manager Job Family is available in our handbook</a>.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>Our Technical Program Management function is relatively new to GitLab; we are building out a PMO that is centralized within Engineering and looking for strong TPMs that are interested in developing a newly formed PMO and standardizing on best practices for the business.<a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/product-development/r-and-d-pmo/"> You can learn more about the PMO in our handbook page.</a></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off </a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a> </li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.  </p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a> and <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div>

title: Strategic Innovation Lead, Operations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/personal">personal</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/business-banking">business</a> bank accounts, we offer <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/joint-account">joint accounts</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/16-17">accounts for 16-17 year olds</a>, a <a href="https://monzo.com/current-account/under-16s">free kids account</a> and <a href="https://monzo.com/flex">credit cards</a> in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also <a href="https://monzo.com/savings">save</a>, <a href="https://monzo.com/investments">invest </a>and <a href="https://monzo.com/pensions">combine their pensions</a> with us. </p> <p>With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!</p> <p>We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️</p> <hr> <p> </p></div><p>📍UK Remote | 💰£68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Benefits</a>  ✨</p> <h4><strong>⭐️ Our Ops Labs Team</strong></h4> <p>We’re building Ops Labs: a small, high-impact team focused on incubating, testing and scaling new ideas that improve customer experience and create enterprise value for Monzo.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, data and experimentation. You’ll take ideas from concept to reality - rapidly testing hypotheses, learning what works (and what doesn’t), and turning the best ideas into scalable solutions across Operations.</p> <p>Many of these ideas will come from our strategy work, customer insight, and experience gaps. Your job is to turn them into tangible experiments, validate their impact, and help scale the ones that meaningfully improve customer outcomes, reduce cost, or unlock new value.</p> <p>This is a zero-to-one role. You’ll need to be comfortable operating with high ambiguity, building structure where none exists, and working hands-on to bring ideas to life.</p> <h4><strong>🔑 You’ll play a key role by...</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Turning ideas into real-world experiments - </strong>Take ideas emerging from strategy, customer insights, and experience gaps, and translate them into testable hypotheses. Design and execute experiments end-to-end — from scoping and setup to execution, measurement and readout — with a strong bias to action and speed.</li> <li><strong>Incubating high-potential opportunities - </strong>Identify and develop early-stage ideas that could significantly improve customer experience, reduce operational demand, or create commercial value. This could include rethinking service models, testing new ways to deliver support, or exploring entirely new capabilities within Ops.</li> <li><strong>Scaling successful experiments into production - </strong>Work closely with product, engineering, data science and operations teams to take successful pilots and scale them. Ensure there is a clear path from experiment → validated impact → operational or product integration.</li> <li><strong>Advancing goodwill and customer experience innovation - </strong>Reimagine how we deliver goodwill and recover from poor experiences — testing new approaches that improve customer trust while being sustainable and scalable. Push beyond incremental fixes to meaningfully raise the bar for customer experience.</li> <li><strong>Creating strong feedback loops with data science and CX insights - </strong>Partner closely with Customer Experience, Data Science and Insights teams to ensure experiments are informed by real customer pain points, and that we rigorously track the impact of changes (e.g. what actually improves CSAT, reduces complaints, or drives engagement).</li> <li><strong>Measuring impact and building the case for change - </strong>Define clear success metrics for experiments (CSAT, demand reduction, cost, engagement, etc.), track outcomes, and communicate results clearly. Build compelling cases to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives based on evidence.</li> <li><strong>Working hands-on with frontline operations (COps) - </strong>Collaborate closely with COps to test ideas in real environments. Use their feedback and expertise to refine experiments and ensure solutions are practical, scalable, and grounded in reality.</li> <li><strong>Pave the way for building a bigger experimentation engine - </strong>Depending on how successful the experiments are, scale the team to make the remit bigger and accelerate commercial opportunities. </li> </ul> <h4><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></h4> <ul> <li>You have experience in strategy, product, operations, or a similar role, with a track record of taking ideas from concept to execution</li> <li>You are highly comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building from zero to one</li> <li>You have strong problem-solving skills and can structure and break down complex, unclear problems</li> <li>You have a bias to action and are comfortable testing ideas quickly rather than over-optimising upfront</li> <li>You are analytical and able to define success metrics, interpret results, and make data-informed decisions</li> <li>You are a strong communicator, able to clearly articulate ideas, experiments, and outcomes to different audiences</li> <li>You are collaborative and can work effectively across functions (Ops, Product, Data, Engineering)</li> <li>You are pragmatic and outcome-focused, balancing speed with quality and impact</li> <li>You are curious about customer experience and motivated to improve it in meaningful ways</li> </ul> <h4>The following would be a bonus:</h4> <ul> <li> <ul> <li>Experience running experiments (A/B testing, pilots, operational trials, etc.)</li> <li>Experience working on zero-to-one products, services, or initiatives</li> <li>Experience in operations, customer support, or service design</li> <li>Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams</li> <li>Experience in a high-growth or fast-changing environment<a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">.</a></li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Application questions - </strong>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here</a></li> <li><strong>Recruiter Call - 30 mins</strong> </li> <li><strong>1st stage Technical Interview - 1 hour</strong></li> <li>and if you pass the 1st stage<strong>, a 2nd stage interview with case study.</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £68,400 to £89,575 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance</p> <p>⏰ This role requires you to work 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday between core hours 8am - 6pm.</p> <p>📍This role is within the UK -<strong> we cannot sponsor Visas for this role</strong></p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. ➕ Plus lots more!<a href="https://monzo.com/careers/"> Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p>Our average process takes around 4 weeks but we'll always work around your availability. You'll have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process, but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact ninaebanksmetcalfe@monzo.com</p> <p><strong>This role will close when we feel we have received enough suitable applications, so please apply early.</strong></p> <p><strong>Good luck 🍀</strong></p> <p><strong><br></strong><strong>#LI-REMOTE #LI-NEM</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/diversity-and-inclusion">blog</a>, 2026 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/our-2026-diversity-and-inclusion-report" target="_blank">Diversity and Inclusion Report</a> and 2025 <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/gender-pay-gap-report-2025">Gender Pay Gap Report.</a></p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.</p> <p>If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊</p></div>

title: Sales Account Executive - Cybersecurity
description: Passionate about Cybersecurity, open-source or network effect products? Interested in Sales? Join CrowdSec to build a safer internet for everyone. What we do We aim to deter opportunistic and organized cybercrime through an Internet-scale, real-time security network. This network is powered by hundreds of thousands of servers sharing the aggression they block with our open-source software. By coupling this local behavior analysis and sharing its findings within our community, we create a real-time map of IP addresses used by cybercriminals, a large-scale reputation system, and a Crowd-Sourced Cyber Threat Intelligence of unprecedented magnitude that will counter the vast majority of technical hacks. Who We Are CrowdSec is a human-sized team of cybersecurity experts. Most of the team has worked remotely since day 1. The CrowdSec solution is used in 180+ countries, it is a well-known, unique, collaborative, open-source security solution that protects hundreds thousands of users. We are animated by a mission: making the Internet a safer place, all together. Role As an Account Executive (AE), you will work with the Sales team to help them scale, create new opportunities, interact with them, convert them to Leads, and take the accounts to signature. This will be done in collaboration with the BDRs, presales, Marketing, and Support teams to ensure the most pleasant customer journey. Must-have A track record of success in selling Cybersecurity software solutions A pre-existing customer/contact base to work on to kickstart your tenure Knowledges of fundamental cybersecurity mechanism Good methodology to deal with inbound leads Good outreach techniques to convert SQLs to clients Experience covering the whole sales process from prospection to signature The ability to build relationships and credibility with both SOC Managers/analysts, DevOps, SecOps, Risk Managers, and C-level Executives alike Predictability and accurate forecasting capabilities Fluency in English and at least a second language; any supplementary languages are considered a plus Optional You have sold to SaaS, PaaS, IaaS, MSSPs or MSPs Knowledge of the open-software landscape Languages other than English and French are considered a plus Start-up experience Experience with Hubspot Soft Skills You are a confident and polished communicator able to build strong and lasting relationships You are autonomous, do not hesitate to share new ideas with the team, and are genuinely interested in learning your customer's needs You are located in a +/- 6h from CEST Timezone Why join CrowdSec? You want to take part in an adventure with a bleeding edge tech startup Work with a team of blackbelt pros in their fields and interact with an exciting community You are driven and energetic, with a passion for prospecting and driving pipeline We are a full-remote company, we meet twice a year to strengthen the team spirit during a 1-week seminar. title: Senior Solution Architect / Lead Automation Engineer (m/w/d)  - GreenTech/Recycling (Teilzeit 32h, Remote möglich)
description: // Technische Verantwortung in einem wachsenden GreenTech-Startup Leiste Pionierarbeit bei ecosistant: ecosistant , ein aufstrebendes und gefragtes Startup in Berlin, wird der Go-To-Point für Onlinehändler rund um Nachhaltigkeit & Recycling und führt die Transformation hin zu einem fairen und ressourcenschonenden E-Commerce im 21. Jahrhundert an. Unsere Mission ist als Team den Onlinehandel nachhaltig zu gestalten und Handelsbarrieren im internationalen E-Commerce im extrem dynamischen Markt der PPWR (EU-Verpackungsverordnung) und EPR (Recycling) abbauen zu helfen. Unser Business ist hochgradig datengetrieben. Um maximale Effizienz zu garantieren, setzen wir konsequent auf intelligente Prozessautomatisierung und Zuverlässigkeit, dennoch ebenso auch auf neue Tools und Anbindungen für unsere Kunden. Unser aktuelles Fundament wurde von unserem Teilzeit-CTO aufgebaut – jetzt suchen wir für ab sofort einen strategischen, analytischen und operativ starken Kopf, der dieses Setup übernimmt, weiter skaliert und unser Team und Prozesse in die Zukunft führt - gerne direkt in Berlin. Aufgaben Deine Rolle & Verantwortung bei uns Als Head of Technical Operations bist du die Brücke zwischen unserer strategischen Vision (3-Jahres-Roadmap) und der operativen Umsetzung. Du hältst unser Startup nachhaltig marktfähig und bist gleichzeitig der analytische Fels in der Brandung für unser Tagesgeschäft. Strategie & 3-Jahres-Roadmap: In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Teilzeit-CTO gestaltest du die mittel- und langfristige Tech- und Automatisierungsstrategie. Du triffst fundierte Make-or-Buy-Entscheidungen und planst den Übergang von No-Code zu proprietären Systemen. Teamführung, Mentoring & Mitarbeit: Du übernimmst die fachliche Führung unseres IT-Mitarbeitenden, legst Taktiken für den operativen Alltag fest und verbesserst kontinuierlich unsere internen IT-Prozesse. Mit deinen analytischen Fähigkeiten unterstützt du bei komplexeren Fehleranalysen, um Problemlösungskompetenzen im Team aufzubauen. Du scheust dich im Tagesgeschäft nicht davor, auch operativ bei Bedarf zu unterstützen und Aufgaben hands-on selbst zu erledigen. Architektur, Datenstrukturen & Skalierung: Du optimierst unser bestehendes System (No-Code Automatisierungsplattformen, Tools für Dateneingaben und unser hauseigenes ERP-System), definierst Datenstrukturen und machst unseren Tech-Stack fit für IT-Audits großer B2B-Kunden (denkbare ERP-Anbindungen wie SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, etc) sowie AI-Anbindungen. Qualitätssicherung (QS) & Prozesse: Du führst Best Practices und optimierst unsere Standards für die No-Code- und Code-Entwicklung ein (Beispiele: Dev/Staging-Umgebungen, striktes Error-Handling, automatisches Fehler-Monitoring, Tracking, lückenlose Dokumentation). Du machst techn. Reviews sowie sorgst für die Bereitstellung qualitativer Testdaten und Testumgebungen. Agile Weiterentwicklungen & Planung von Refacturings : Du konzipierst nachhaltige Lösungsansätze mit, definierst einheitliche Datenmodelle und Protokolle, und bist Ansprechpartner einerseits für Product-Owner, im Business Development als auch bei Mitwirkenden in der jeweiligen Umsetzung. Bei komplexen oder geschäftskritischen Parts von Umsetzungen hilfst du bei Bedarf mit oder sorgst dafür, dass sie gewissenhaft, sicher, qualitativ und nachhaltig umgesetzt werden. Analytische Exzellenz: Wenn Datenflüsse stocken, API-Limits erreicht werden oder unvorhergesehene Fehler in den Tool-Schnittstellen auftreten, unterstützt du bei Bedarf die Ursachenanalyse tiefgehend und systematisch, entwickelst nachhaltige Lösungen für die Zukunft und leitest die Behebung an. Qualifikation Das bringst du mit (Dein Profil) Erfahrung im Startup-Umfeld: Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer gestaltenden oder anleitenden IT/Operations-Rolle und liebst das dynamische Umfeld eines Startups. No-Code- & API-Experte mit Code-Verständnis: Du beherrschst eine No-Code-Plattform (n8n, Make, etc.) auf Experten-Niveau (Webhooks, API-Anbindungen, Fehler-Handling, komplexe Daten-Operationen, asynchrone eventbasierte Architekturen). Du verstehst relationale Datenbankstrukturen im Detail. Du hast Erfahrungen in Code (PHP, JavaScript), um entwickelte Framework-Plugins im Blick zu behalten. Starke analytische Denkweise: Du besitzt eine ausgeprägte Fähigkeit zur Ursachenanalyse (Root-Cause-Analysis) sowie Konzeption verbesserter Ansätze. Du verlierst bei komplexen, verschachtelten Systemen und Datenströmen nicht den Überblick und liebst es, Ungereimtheiten bei uns systematisch aufzuspüren und nachhaltig Lösungsansätze zu etablieren. Hands-on-Mentalität & Flexibilität: Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit operativer Tatkraft. Du bist dir nicht "zu fein", selbst Datenfelder anzulegen oder Automatisierungs-Szenarien zu klicken. Empathische Führungskraft: Du hast echte Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben, Leitplanken zu setzen und zukünftige Nachwuchstalente strukturiert und geduldig aufzubauen. Benefits Wir sind kein Konzern mit gigantischen IT-Gehältern, Hierarchien und fehlender Wirksamkeit. Es ist viel besser: Direkter Impact: Du gestaltest die Zukunft in einem der wichtigsten regulatorischen Märkte der nächsten Jahre (PPWR, EPR & verbessertes Recycling von Materialien) Co-CTO Perspektive**:** Enge Zusammenarbeit und strategisches Sparring direkt mit dem Gründerteam und dem CTO. Ein unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in attraktivem Teilzeit-Modell, das zu dir passt (32h/Woche) Flexible Arbeitszeit- und -ortgestaltung (permanentes, mobiles Arbeiten möglich) Die Möglichkeit Dich frei zu entfalten und weiterzuentwickeln Ein aufgeschlossenes und junges Team (Kreativität und freies Denken erwünscht) Du lernst unsere Tools, Philosophie und Ziele kennen, damit Du Dich in Deinem neuen Aufgabengebiet sicher fühlst Angenehme und kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre (auch Remote) Regelmäßige Team-Events mit hohem Spaßfaktor & Teamübergreifendes Netzwerken Unterstützung von Klimaschutz-Initiativen Gehaltspaket mit mehreren Mitarbeitenden-Benefits sowie attraktiver Vergütung je nach Erfahrungsgrad Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte Nachhaltigkeit mit. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Wenn du eine Leidenschaft für Nachhaltigkeit hast und dich einbringen und unsere Mission mit gestalten möchtest, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Spaß bei der Arbeit gehört, genauso wie flexible Arbeitszeit und -Ort selbstverständlich bei uns dazu. Wir arbeiten in Berlin oder bleiben insbesondere digital jederzeit in Kontakt, damit sich alle bei uns wohl- und keiner sich (beim mobilen Arbeiten) allein fühlt! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung! Gerne mit Deiner frühestmöglichen Verfügbarkeit und Deiner Gehaltsvorstellung. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

You know what a good test codebase looks like and you constantly improve it API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy Have set up and used Service Level Objectives to define a contract of system reliability with stakeholders, and driven measurable improvements against them Native AI-assisted working style. You can describe projects where AI meaningfully changed how you worked - test authoring, failure triage, coverage analysis - and where you decided it wasn't the right tool Coaching other disciplines in quality. You evangelise quality practices and get others on board to solve quality problems together Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator, able to chase things down when blocked Able to operate independently and drive improvements end-to-end (frameworks, CI, test data, reporting) Can point to 3-4 projects where you moved the needle on quality - for example improving SLO coverage or reducing incident rate - and can speak to the measurable impact of each Nice to have Hands-on experience testing React Native apps. Mobile performance and reliability work (crash reporting, startup time, memory and battery awareness). API and contract testing experience, with a point of view on test data and environment strategy. Our tech stack Mobile: TypeScript, React Native, Expo, EAS, GraphQL, Relay, Jest, React Testing Library, Maestro. Backend: Kotlin, PHP 8 (Symfony), AWS, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes. Tooling and observability: GitHub, GitHub Actions, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, Sentry, Grafana. Why join? title: Technical Program Manager
description: SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution! About the role Platform work at SoSafe carries outsized leverage. One well-run migration touches a dozen services at once. One adopted shared library saves every team that builds on it from solving the same problem twice. One monitoring signal catches a problem before a customer ever sees it. The work often goes unnoticed when it's going well, but its absence is felt across half of Product Development within a week. We're hiring a Technical Program Manager to embed into one of our platform teams and bring order to that complexity. You'll partner closely with the Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and their Tech Leads to drive the when and how of the roadmap: sequencing the work, surfacing risk early, holding cross-team commitments together, and making sure what ships lands cleanly across every team that depends on it. This role owns program outcomes, not status reports. You'll think in systems, work in mechanisms, and earn trust by removing friction the team didn't know was costing them time. Here's how you'll make a difference Own end-to-end delivery for programs that touch a dozen services at once: an architecture migration, a compliance remediation, a legacy system sunset. Partner with Product Management and GTM stakeholders on platform changes with customer-facing impact, keeping rollouts, communications, and external commitments in lockstep with engineering delivery. Drive adoption of shared platform capabilities that other teams are supposed to build on, closing the gap between "we shipped it" and teams actually using it. Manage multi-team migrations where downstream consumers, external commitments, and legacy constraints all need to land in the right order. A missed dependency here costs months, not days. Run the mechanics that keep a dozen concurrent programs honest: dependency maps, risk logs, decision records, and the recurring check-ins nobody wants to run but everybody needs. Bring rigor to how delivery health gets measured, incident counts, adoption rates, time-to-land, and use it to drive change instead of producing another report. What makes you a great fit You've run complex, cross-functional technical programs and can point to ones where the technical decisions were yours to shape, not just to track. You hold your own in deep engineering conversations. You don't need to write the code, but you need to understand what's being argued about and why it matters. You bring structure to ambiguity without over-engineering it. Your default is the lightest mechanism that solves the problem. You've worked where the consumers of your output are other engineering teams, whether that's infrastructure, data pipelines, or internal APIs. You've managed a migration or sunset with real downstream impact, and you know how to land it without breaking trust. You communicate directly. Short sentences, clear asks, no filler. You write decisions down and make sure the right people see them. You're comfortable in Jira, Confluence, and the rest of a modern engineering toolchain, and you have opinions about how they should be used. Nice to have Background in infrastructure, data engineering, or applied AI/ML platforms. Experience inside a SaaS company through a phase of platform consolidation or modernization. Familiarity with SLOs or monitoring practice as a delivery signal, not just an SRE artifact. What success looks like 3 months. You're embedded with the team's engineering leadership, have a clear read on every active program, and have started reshaping how the group plans, tracks, and communicates delivery. 6 months. You're the trusted operating partner for the group. Initiatives that were drifting are landing predictably, and the cross-team dependencies that used to surprise us are surfacing weeks earlier. 12 months. The team is delivering with a rhythm other groups want to copy. The mechanisms you built are running themselves, and you're picking the next compounding problem to solve. What we offer* Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ *Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process. About Us At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence. Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us. If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you! description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><em>🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.</em></strong></p> <p>We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.</p> <p>After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Risk Oversight team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Risk Oversight Manager to join us!</p> <p>Our Credit Risk Oversight team is crucial in providing support and challenge to our Borrowing teams in the first line of defence to help Monzo grow safely. We’re looking for someone (maybe you?!) with proven experience in consumer credit risk who likes getting into the details and analysing data to deliver independent assurance - and challenge - of credit risk management across the lifecycle. </p> <p>Ideally you’ll have experience and in-depth knowledge of retail unsecured or small business credit risk strategy within financial services. You’ll have seen first-hand how a credit portfolio performs at different stages of the credit cycle, and have hands-on experience in shaping or overseeing lending strategies. You’ll have a collaborative approach, and be comfortable working across a broad range of stakeholders. You’ll also be someone who likes getting into the details, analysing data and providing constructive challenges.</p> <p><strong>🔑You’ll play a key role by...</strong></p> <p><strong>Providing ongoing oversight of credit risk - this includes analysing and understanding the performance of our existing lending products, developing and enhancing monitoring metrics and providing input to relevant committees and forums  </strong></p> <ul> <li>Partnering with our first line of defence teams to support credit strategy changes - including new product launches and pilots - ensuring that we deliver magical lending products for our customers while meeting our Risk Appetite</li> <li>Delivering deep insight, feedback and challenge on our credit strategies - including data-driven analysis and actionable counter-proposals - to support management decision making and shaping better outcomes for our customers</li> <li>Leading second line assurance work on thematic reviews</li> <li>Collaborating with our model validation and model development teams to ensure understanding of the models that underpin our credit strategies</li> <li>Providing credit expertise and input into relevant strategic projects and critical Monzo-wide processes, such as stress-testing and forecasting</li> <li>Supporting us in maintaining our Credit Risk Framework and making sure it is well embedded within the business</li> <li>Taking a balanced and proportionate approach to risk management, making sure that managing risks becomes part of everyone at Monzo’s day-to-day role</li> </ul> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you …</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have a strong background in credit risk management within consumer or small business lending - experience in unsecured product, such as credit cards, loans or overdrafts would be particularly beneficial</li> <li>Have proven analytical skills, and can use these to interrogate data, build monitoring and look for early indicators of trends</li> <li>Have hands-on experience and/or understanding of how to use credit risk scorecards and NPV models to develop strategies for making credit decisions</li> <li>Have a solid technical toolkit; SQL or similar is a must-have, and experience using a data visualisation tool (such as Looker, PowerBI or Tableau) is a plus</li> <li>Are excited to explore how we can use AI tools to improve our credit and risk management processes</li> <li>Can convey problems and solutions using clear and simple language, both written and verbal (see <a href="https://monzo.com/tone-of-voice/">Monzo’s tone of voice</a> guide). This is particularly important for communicating complex issues and priorities to non-experts</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders, while providing effective and respectful challenge</li> <li>Are passionate about technology, and what we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!</li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply - even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £79,900-95,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London) </p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.</p> <p><strong>🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps</strong></p> <ul> <li>An initial call with our recruiter</li> <li>A call with one of our Credit Risk Oversight Managers, the hiring manager(s) for the role </li> <li>A take-home task</li> <li>Two competency, based interviews - one role specific technical interview and one behaviours and values interview</li> </ul> <p>This process should take around 4-8 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p>#LI-TK1<strong><br><br></strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Chief Financial Officer (all genders)

title: Technical Recruiter (gn) Schwerpunkt Softwareentwicklung
description: Technical Recruiter (gn), remote, vollzeit, ab sofort. Du erkennst, ob hinter einem technischen Profil die Erfahrung steckt, die ein Projekt wirklich braucht? Und du hast Freude daran, passende Menschen zu finden und für eine Zusammenarbeit zu gewinnen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen. Wir suchen eine_n_ Technical Recruiter (gn) _, der/_die uns bei der Besetzung unserer offenen Stellen unterstützt. Aktuell liegt der Schwerpunkt auf Softwareentwicklung. Perspektivisch suchen wir auch für Rollen im Produkt- und Projektumfeld, etwa Product Owner, Projektmanager:_innen und Business Analyst:_innen. New Monday ist eine UX/UI-Agentur aus Berlin. Wir arbeiten an digitalen Produkten für Unternehmen wie Atruvia, DAK, SAP und Lufthansa sowie für junge Unternehmen wie NUMA Stays. Unser Team arbeitet zu 100% remote. Dabei setzen wir auf eigenständiges Arbeiten, kurze Wege und einen engen Austausch miteinander – digital und immer öfter auch bei persönlichen Treffen. Aufgaben Du begleitest die Besetzung unserer technischen Positionen – aktuell vor allem in der Softwareentwicklung, perspektivisch auch in Rollen wie Product Ownership, Projektmanagement und Business Analyse. Du sichtest eingehende Bewerbungen, ordnest Profile fachlich ein und beurteilst, wie gut Erfahrung und Projekthintergrund zu unseren Anforderungen passen. Bei Bedarf findest du passende Kandidat*innen über LinkedIn und weitere Recruiting-Kanäle und sprichst sie persönlich an. Du führst erste Gespräche und klärst technische Erfahrung, Motivation sowie Rahmendaten wie Verfügbarkeit und Gehaltsvorstellung. Du stimmst dich eng mit unseren fachlichen Ansprechpartner:innen ab, bereitest Interviews vor und begleitest Kandidat:innen verbindlich durch den gesamten Prozess. Du pflegst unsere Bewerbungsprozesse im Bewerbersystem und sorgst dafür, dass Informationen an den Schnittstellen zwischen Recruiting, Fachbereichen und Geschäftsführung zuverlässig fließen. Du beobachtest den Markt und gibst uns Rückmeldung, wie wir unsere Suche und Ansprache verbessern können. Qualifikation Du hast Erfahrung im Recruiting und Active Sourcing technischer Fachkräfte und hast insbesondere Positionen in der Softwareentwicklung bereits erfolgreich besetzt. Du verstehst die Unterschiede zwischen Frontend-, Backend- und Fullstack-Profilen und kannst praktische Projekterfahrung gezielt hinterfragen. Idealerweise kennst du auch Profile aus dem Produkt- und Projektumfeld. Begriffe wie Angular, TypeScript, Java, Spring Boot, REST-APIs, CI/CD und Kubernetes sind dir vertraut. Du musst nicht selbst entwickeln können, kannst technische Lebensläufe aber sicher einordnen und mit Kandidat*innen auf Augenhöhe sprechen. Du arbeitest routiniert mit Bewerbermanagementsystemen und digitalen Recruiting-Tools. Erfahrung mit JOIN ist ein Plus. Du kommunizierst wertschätzend und sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch – sowohl schriftlich als auch im Gespräch. Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und transparent und behältst mehrere Suchprozesse gleichzeitig im Blick. Du bist offen dafür, KI-Tools sinnvoll für Recherche, Ansprache und die Organisation deiner Arbeit einzusetzen und prüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig. Benefits Das erwartet dich bei New Monday 100 % remote: Du arbeitest innerhalb Deutschlands von dem Ort aus, der für dich passt. Flexibilität und Vertrauen: Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag eigenständig, mit kurzen Abstimmungswegen und ohne Micromanagement. Ein Team, das sich auch persönlich trifft: Neben dem digitalen Austausch schaffen wir bewusst Raum für regionale Treffen und gemeinsames Coworking. Ein- bis zweimal im Jahr kommt das gesamte Team zusammen. Zeit und Budget für deine Entwicklung: Wir fördern fachliche Weiterbildung und den Austausch im Team. Nach der Probezeit steht dir dafür ein Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 € zur Verfügung. Entwicklung mit Perspektive: Wir arbeiten aktuell an einem Karriereentwicklungsplan, der Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und nächste Schritte bei New Monday transparenter machen soll. Deine eigenen Ziele und Interessen besprechen wir dabei regelmäßig mit dir. 30 Tage Urlaub und zusätzlich zwei Tage für unsere Team-Events. Arbeit mit Gestaltungsspielraum: Du bringst deine Erfahrung ein und hilfst uns, unser Recruiting für technische Rollen weiterzuentwickeln. So geht es weiter Erstes Kennenlernen: Wir erzählen dir mehr über New Monday und die Rolle. Du berichtest uns von deiner Erfahrung und kannst alle Fragen stellen, die dir wichtig sind. Gespräch mit unseren Co-Foundern Laura Nielsen und Dario Zampetti: Wir lernen uns ausführlicher kennen und sprechen darüber, wie du technische Recruiting-Prozesse gestaltest und mit unseren Fachbereichen zusammenarbeiten würdest. Fachliches Follow-up: Anhand konkreter Recruiting-Situationen sprechen wir darüber, wie du Bewerbungen einschätzt, passende Kandidat*innen findest und Entscheidungen vorbereitest. Du bekommst außerdem Gelegenheit, mit einer Person aus dem Team unter vier Augen zu sprechen. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Ein Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf – auch wenn du nicht jede Anforderung vollständig erfüllst. New Monday fördert die Gleichstellung aller Beschäftigten. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität. title: Head of GTM, Research Services | AI-Native Research (Remote US/EU)
description: About Maze Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development. In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in. We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision. Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves. That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey —and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more. Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values . About the Role Maze is launching a Market Research service that blends the scale and speed of our platform with expert-led research services, creating an AI-native alternative to traditional market research agencies. As Head of GTM, Research Services , you'll be the founding commercial leader for this new line of business. This is a high-profile role that will work closely with Senior Leaders at Maze. Reporting to the COO and partnering closely with our Head of Market Research, the expert practitioner delivering the service, you'll own go-to-market strategy end to end. Key responsibilities include partnering with Product, Sales and Marketing to design, build and run our GTM motion, engaging new buyers and existing customers to initiate opportunities, managing deals through to close, and working with Marketing to build Maze's voice and presence in the market research industry. This is a rare opportunity to build a new business at an inflection point, helping define how AI reshapes the future of market research. You'll thrive here if you're a builder with deep market research roots—someone who has carried a number, knows the industry and its buyers personally, and believes AI is rewriting how research gets done. What You'll Do: GTM Strategy & Service Design Define and co-own the go-to-market strategy for Maze's Market Research service; positioning, packaging, pricing, and target segments. Partner with the Head of Market Research to shape the offering around what insights buyers actually need and what our AI-native approach makes possible. Establish the metrics, forecasts, and operating cadence for a new line of business, and iterate quickly on what the market tells you. Pipeline Generation & Sales Partnership Coordinate with our existing sales team to generate qualified pipeline Partner with Sales and Marketing to deliver enablement, playbooks, joint account planning, and outbound plays. Activate your own market research network to open doors with insights leaders and research buyers. Manage opportunities through the full sales cycle: scoping, proposals, pricing, negotiation, and close - bringing in the Head of Market Research as the practitioner voice. Marketing Partnership & Market Presence Partner with Marketing to build Maze's voice and presence in the market research category—content, events, communities, and thought leadership. Represent Maze at industry events and in the broader conversation about how AI is changing research. Turn early customer wins into stories, references, and repeatable demand. Building the Business Act as the connective tissue between Sales, Marketing, Research, and Product, surfacing what the market needs and feeding it back into the service and platform roadmap. Bring AI into your own daily workflow to do more with less—and model that for the team around you. As the service scales, help shape the team and playbook that will grow it. Who You Are: Experience Significant experience growing market research services, insights consulting, or research technology businesses, including ownership of commercial outcomes. A very strong network of market research buyers and practitioners you can activate from day one. Deep market research domain expertise: qual and quant methodologies, study design, and how insights organizations buy and operate. Ideally, some management and entrepreneurial experience—you've built a practice, launched an offering, or started something of your own. Skills & Strengths AI-pilled: You understand how AI can improve every step of the research process, and you already use it daily to do more with less. Builder: You thrive in zero-to-one environments—comfortable with ambiguity, quick to create structure, and energized by owning outcomes. Consultative seller: You sell expertise, not just software—confident scoping complex research engagements and navigating enterprise buying processes. Category evangelist: You have a point of view on where research is heading and can make buyers, analysts, and practitioners want to be part of it. Cross-functional operator: You work fluidly with sales, marketing, research, and product teams, and know how to get things done without formal authority. Bonus Experience launching a new service or product line inside a scaling company. Published thought leadership or public speaking on AI in market research. Experience selling both platform (SaaS) and services (agency) motions. Inclusivity and Pay At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. Why Maze is unique Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze. Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge. Outreach Notice We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application , as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.

title: Enterprise Account Director – EMEA
description: MaintainX is a leading mobile-first work execution platform for industrial and frontline teams. More than 13,000 customers , including Duracell, McDonald's, Shell, DHL and Volvo, use MaintainX to cut unplanned downtime and run better operations, across 13.9 million managed assets and 79.5 million completed work orders. In August 2026 MaintainX became part of Autodesk, joining Autodesk Operations Solutions , the organization unifying Autodesk's operations platform alongside Tandem, FlexSim and Fusion Operations. Autodesk's strategy is to converge design, make and operate into one continuous lifecycle: design an asset, build it, run it, then feed what you learn running it back into the next design. Autodesk had design and make. Operate is the phase that tells you what actually happened, and it is ours. Location: UK, remote Travel: Regular travel across EMEA required Reports to: Sr. Director of Sales, EMEA The Role MaintainX is expanding its enterprise presence across EMEA, and we’re rapidly expanding our sales team focused on the UK & Ireland market, with the potential to expand your territory to the rest of Europe Middle East and Africa depending on experience This is a new-logo sales role for someone who knows how to build pipeline, create urgency with complex industrial buyers, and close multi-site enterprise deals. You’ll work closely with our EMEA sales leadership to establish the regional motion, win early reference customers, and help shape how MaintainX goes to market across the region. This is not an account-management seat. We’re looking for a senior hunter who is energized by building territory from the ground up, selling into operational environments, and turning unfamiliar accounts into long-term strategic customers. What You’ll Do Own new-logo enterprise growth across a UK&I-led EMEA territory, closing complex, multi-site deals from first conversation through signature. Build and manage your own pipeline through targeted prospecting, executive outreach, partner signals, and coordinated campaigns with BDR and Marketing. Sell to operational and executive buyers — including COOs, VP Operations, Reliability, Engineering, and Maintenance leaders — using the language of uptime, OEE, MTTR, safety, and asset performance. Lead full-cycle enterprise sales motions, including discovery, business-case development, multi-threading, stakeholder alignment, procurement, negotiation, and close. Build territory plans that prioritize the right accounts, industries, and expansion opportunities across the region. Navigate 6–12+ stakeholder buying committees and maintain disciplined forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and mutual action plans. Bring market feedback back to Product, Marketing, and GTM leadership to help sharpen how MaintainX wins in EMEA. What We’re Looking For 7+ years of enterprise B2B software closing experience, with a track record of owning full-cycle sales into large, complex organizations. Experience selling €250K–€1M+ ACV deals, ideally across multi-site or operationally complex environments. Proven hunter DNA: you have personally sourced, developed, and closed cold enterprise accounts rather than relying primarily on inbound demand or an established regional brand. Experience selling into manufacturing, industrials, energy, utilities, facilities, logistics, or other asset-intensive environments. Comfort building a territory from an early stage — whether in a new region, startup environment, new product category, or underdeveloped market. Strong executive presence with the ability to create credibility quickly with operational leaders and C-suite stakeholders. Multi-country EMEA sales experience, with an understanding of how buying processes, procurement, and decision-making differ across markets. High discipline around pipeline management, forecasting, account strategy, and deal execution. You’ll join at a meaningful inflection point: strong global traction, early EMEA expansion, and the opportunity to help define the enterprise motion in-region. We offer a competitive package, meaningful equity, and the chance to help build a category-defining company. What’s in it for you: Competitive salary and meaningful equity opportunities. title: Head of Market Research | AI-Native Research (Remote US/EU)
description: About Maze Maze is the user research platform that helps companies build the right products faster by making user insights available at the speed of product development. In most companies, research demand far exceeds supply. Time, cost, and lack of access to expertise hold teams back. In today’s AI-powered world, anyone can build a product fast. The real challenge? Deeply understanding user needs and building the right product. That’s where Maze comes in. We believe companies shouldn’t have to choose between building fast and building right. Maze makes research accessible, intuitive, and fast so product teams can put user insights at the center of every decision. Our platform enables researchers, designers, and product managers to quickly recruit participants, run studies autonomously, and surface insights that actually drive product decisions. Our AI capabilities automate the busywork and add depth and direction to the insights themselves. That’s why Maze was recently named the #1 user research platform in UX Tools’ Design Tools Survey —and why we’re scaling fast across industries like B2B SaaS, e-Commerce, Financial Services, Retail, and Automotive, supporting world class customers such as Uber, Amazon, Atlassian, Anthropic & more. Maze is a Series B company backed by top-tier investors (Felicis, Emergence & Amplify). We operate a global remote workforce driven by our core values . About the Role Maze is launching a Market Research service that blends the scale and speed of our platform with expert led research services, creating an AI-native alternative to traditional market research agencies. As Head of Market Research , you'll be the founding research leader for this new line of business. Reporting to the CEO and partnering closely with the Head of GTM, Research Services, you'll define what great market research looks like for the next generation of insights organizations. You'll own the research vision, methodologies, service delivery, and quality bar while helping shape the future of research alongside Product, Engineering, and GTM. This is a rare opportunity to build a modern market research organization from the ground up. We're looking for someone with deep methodological expertise, a strong point of view on where the industry is headed, and the curiosity to rethink how research can evolve alongside new technologies and changing customer expectations. You'll thrive here if you're equal parts practitioner, builder, and innovator—someone who has spent years earning credibility in market research and is now excited to redefine what the next generation of research can become. What You'll Do Research Strategy & Service Design Define the long-term vision for Maze's Market Research service and establish what best-in-class research looks like in an AI-native world. Design and evolve our research methodologies across qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-method studies. Partner closely with the Head of GTM to shape service offerings, ensuring our commercial strategy is grounded in exceptional research quality. Evaluate emerging technologies and evolving research practices to continuously improve how research is designed, delivered, and synthesized. Build the Research Function Build and lead the Market Research organization, establishing the operating model, delivery processes, quality standards, and hiring strategy. Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of researchers as the business scales. Create repeatable systems that allow Maze to deliver exceptional research with greater speed, consistency, and efficiency than traditional agencies. Establish quality assurance frameworks while balancing methodological rigor with the agility our customers expect. Research Delivery & Customer Partnership Serve as the executive research lead on strategic customer engagements, ensuring every project delivers meaningful business outcomes. Guide study design, research approaches, analysis, and executive storytelling for our highest-impact customers. Partner with customers to understand complex business problems and translate them into actionable research strategies. Continuously improve our delivery model based on customer feedback and market evolution. Cross-Functional Leadership Partner closely with Product and Engineering to help shape the future of Maze's research capabilities and ensure our platform continues to meet the evolving needs of research teams. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure our research expertise is reflected throughout the customer journey. Help establish Maze as a trusted authority in the market research industry through customer conversations, industry events, publications, and thought leadership. Act as the voice of the researcher internally, ensuring product and commercial decisions remain grounded in customer insight and research excellence. Who You Are Experience Significant experience leading market research teams, research consulting practices, or insights organizations. Deep expertise across qualitative and quantitative methodologies, research design, sampling, analysis, and insight generation. Experience building or scaling research organizations, practices, or service offerings. Strong executive presence with the ability to advise senior leaders and enterprise customers on research strategy. Experience partnering cross-functionally across commercial, product, and operational teams. Skills & Strengths Research visionary You have a clear perspective on where market research is heading and enjoy building new capabilities, services, and ways of working that help customers make better decisions. Future-focused You have a point of view on where market research is heading and are excited by how new technologies—including AI—can improve the way research is designed, delivered, and consumed. You're curious, adaptable, and eager to help shape what's next for the industry. Builder You thrive in zero-to-one environments. You're comfortable creating structure from ambiguity, building teams, and establishing entirely new ways of working. Methodology expert You're respected for your research expertise and know when to challenge conventional approaches. You balance methodological rigor with practical business outcomes. Executive partner You communicate complex research clearly, influence senior stakeholders, and build trusted relationships across customers, executives, and cross-functional teams. Bonus Experience modernizing research organizations through new technologies, automation, or innovative research practices. Experience launching a new research practice, consultancy, or service line. Public speaking, publishing, or thought leadership within the market research industry. Experience working across both agency and client-side research organizations. Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams to build research technology. Inclusivity and Pay At Maze, we are dedicated to building an equitable, inclusive, and authentic workspace. Unique and diverse perspectives are welcomed, and continuous growth is encouraged. We believe that people are more than their resumes, so if your past experience looks different than the criteria listed, we'd still love to hear from you. We appreciate and celebrate non-traditional life routes and encourage you to apply should you connect with a job description or the Maze culture. Maze values transparency and it enables us to approach compensation equitably across the world. We are informed by data and regularly check our salary ranges (either United States or Rest of World) against other venture backed companies. Additionally, we are proud of our holistic and generous benefits offerings, included in every compensation package. Your salary is dependent upon many factors, including years of experience, expertise, etc. During your first interview, you can expect to have an open conversation with your recruiter regarding your compensation expectations. Why Maze is unique Early-stage startup: You will join an early-stage startup with less than 150 team members. This means you'll have the unique opportunity to directly impact success and help shape the future of Maze. Market disruption: We believe that the way companies build products is fundamentally broken and the user research market is ripe for disruption. For too long, companies have been forced to choose between rapid development without user insights or investing months into research before bringing products to market. But there's finally a groundswell building around a path forward that eliminates this compromise - and Maze is leading the charge. Product-market Fit: Maze is used by 100,000+ brands across 4,000 companies, from SMB to enterprises, and in the last fiscal year, we saw 6.5M questions answered, supporting 25K decisions Benefits Health insurance with international coverage, vision, and dental: 100% of the team member premium paid For some locations, coverage options vary, please see our benefits pages for more information Free access to proper mental health care, unlimited virtual therapy sessions (with a human) and 24/7 access to resources Life and Disability Insurance, 100% of the team member premium paid Flexible time off Meaningful equity Company retreats, fully paid for by Maze New MacBook (laptop), paid for by Maze Paid Family leave: 16 weeks for birth or adoptive parents $500/month to be used for dependent health insurance coverage If you don't have dependents to add to your plan, you will still get access to this money to be used at your discretion to get the benefits that matter to you with our flexible a-maze-ing benefits - gym memberships, co-working spaces, food, travel, whatever! $1,500 remote work setup fund to ensure you can set up a productive work space Flexible work schedule where you manage your own working hours Monthly Bonus.ly points that are awarded to others to recognize teamwork, dedication and helpfulness - points can be cashed out for gift cards and more Virtual social engagements randomly throughout the year SWAG, we have some really cool swag Open, transparent culture that includes virtual: coffee chats, bi-weekly all-hands meetings, and more Check out all of our a-maze-ing benefits here . Outreach Notice We understand you might be excited about the job you’re applying for, we are excited you are interested! However, please refrain from reaching out to our current team members on LinkedIn for referrals. Our policy is that referrals can only be provided by team members who personally know the candidate. With the high volume of interest in our roles, contacting our team members who are not involved in recruitment can be overwhelming. Additionally, please avoid submitting support tickets regarding your application , as our support team is not involved in the hiring process. Rest assured, our recruitment team is diligently reviewing all applications and will reach out directly if there is a match.
