title: Support Engineer (AMER)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support Engineering at GitLab isn’t just a title - you will be embedded within the Engineering department and will truly operate in an environment where Support and Engineering meet. You’ll interact with customers daily as they encounter the difficult edge cases of running GitLab in complex environments. In the space of a day, you might be doing behind the scenes work of a Linux administrator troubleshooting performance problems by using strace on a particular process, interacting with the Product team to ensure that steps in a bug report are reproducible, or interacting with the Engineering team itself by diving deep into our codebase and putting together a merge request to actually fix a customer issue. </span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">That’s not all though - you’d equally be invited to contribute to the source code, improve our documentation, and help build out more efficient support processes in our issue tracker. We want to live in a world where everyone can contribute, and as a member of the support team, there are no barriers to using your skills to improve the experience of our users and customers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><br></span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Some examples of our projects: </span></p> <ul> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlab-detective">A tool to automatically check a GitLab Omnibus install for known issues</a></li> <li>A<a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/gitlabsos"> solution to capture the state of a customer’s server</a> for easier troubleshooting</li> <li><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/toolbox/sosparser">A tool which turns log files into interactive tables to easily sort and filter columns</a></li> <li>A functionality to<a href="https://docs.gitlab.com/ee/ci/chatops/"> ChatOps</a> to make it easier to identify user accounts on GitLab.com</li> </ul> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">  </span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support a mix of Self-managed and GitLab.com (SaaS) customers and resolve their issues via Zendesk tickets, merge requests, email and video conferencing</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with our </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/product/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Product</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/development/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Development</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/engineering/infrastructure/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Infrastructure</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">, </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/customer-success/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Customer Success</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/sales/"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sales</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Teams to build new features and fix bugs, define and shape the product goals, roadmap, priorities, and strategy</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Create and update documentation based on customer interactions</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Collaborate with Support team members (through </span><a href="https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-pairing/?_gl=1%2a1vj7usl%2a_ga%2aMTYyOTI0OTAxNC4xNjc4NzIwMDg0%2a_ga_ENFH3X7M5Y%2aMTY4NDgzNDU0OC4xMTAuMS4xNjg0ODM2NDM3LjAuMC4w"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Pairing Sessions</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">) and other GitLab team members (for example: as a </span><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/support/#support-stable-counterpart"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Support Stable Counterpart</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Participate in regular rotations for weekday and weekend on-call coverage (daytime only), providing emergency support to our Self-managed and SaaS customers, or working with our SaaS Production team to coordinate incident communications</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Participate in our hiring processes by reviewing applications and assessments, and by participating in interviews.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll bring </strong></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience in, and passion for managing customer facing cases throughout the entire support lifecycle from initial customer inquiry to triage and reproduction, writing bug reports for hand off to the development team, and case resolution</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Excellent Linux systems administration knowledge (LFCE or RHCE equivalent knowledge)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to use scripting languages (preferably Ruby or Bash), and MVC frameworks (preferably Ruby on Rails)</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Experience with Git and CI/CD</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Expertise in writing support content </span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Ability to communicate complex technical topics to customers and coworkers of varying technical skill level</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and technologies like Serverless and Kubernetes</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Understand a range of different GitLab implementations, and how service interruptions impact the customer.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Support team is distributed all over the world across AMER, EMEA, and APAC regions. Support Engineers work on Support Tickets and helping GitLab’s customers, but they also dig into the code and logs to find out why something is not working as expected. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h4><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h4> <p>At GitLab, we’re looking for a Talent Brand Manager to shape how current and prospective team members understand what it means to work here. You’ll bring GitLab’s employer value proposition to life through storytelling, recruitment marketing, candidate education, and experiences that connect our external reputation to our internal culture. You’ll partner across GitLab to turn talent brand strategy into campaigns and content throughout the candidate journey.</p> <p>This role is a strong fit for a brand, recruitment marketing, employer brand, or content professional who can move between strategy and execution. You’ll use editorial judgment, data, and cross-functional collaboration to create clear, inclusive, and authentic candidate experiences.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong>  </p> <ul> <li value="1">Translate GitLab’s employer value proposition and company direction into clear, differentiated, and authentic candidate-facing messaging.</li> <li value="2">Deliver integrated talent brand campaigns across careers content, social media, employer review platforms, talent communities, events, and recruiter channels.</li> <li value="3">Develop and curate stories featuring team members, leaders, teams, culture, values, career growth, and the impact of working at GitLab.</li> <li value="4">Partner with Talent Acquisition to create targeted content and campaigns that support hiring priorities, pipeline generation, and conversion.</li> <li value="5">Improve candidate journey touchpoints with transparent, consistent, and relevant information throughout the hiring process.</li> <li value="6">Use content, channel, candidate feedback, and funnel metrics to improve performance and communicate impact.</li> <li value="7">Collaborate across GitLab to ensure content is accurate, inclusive, culturally relevant, and aligned with our voice.</li> <li value="8">Manage projects and external partners while improving talent brand processes, systems, reporting, and operations through iteration and thoughtful use of technology and artificial intelligence tools.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You’ll Bring </strong></p> <ul> <li value="1">Experience in talent brand, employer brand, recruitment marketing, content strategy, communications, or a related field.</li> <li value="2">Experience translating a brand or employer value proposition into content, campaigns, or audience experiences.</li> <li value="3">Strong storytelling, writing, editing, and editorial judgment across multiple channels.</li> <li value="4">Experience planning and delivering campaigns or programs with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and deadlines.</li> <li value="5">Comfort using performance data, audience insights, feedback, and market research to improve outcomes.</li> <li value="6">Experience influencing across functions and working with senior stakeholders, subject matter experts, creative partners, or vendors.</li> <li value="7">Ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing work, and move from strategy to detailed execution in an asynchronous environment.</li> <li value="8">A commitment to inclusive, transparent storytelling, alignment with GitLab’s values and remote working practices, and applicable work authorization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the team</strong></p> <p>The GitLab Talent Brand team helps candidates understand what it means to work here through marketing, storytelling, partnerships, candidate education, and recruiter enablement. We evolve GitLab’s employer narrative, strengthen regional presence, improve talent content and platforms, support targeted attraction, and use data to understand our impact on candidate engagement and hiring outcomes.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. Enablement is instrumental in helping GitLab grow at a more accelerated pace and achieve our ambitious revenue targets. sales management</li> <li>Analyze wins and losses, contribute to root cause analysis, and share lessons learned with account managers, marketing, and technical teams to improve future outcomes</li> issues, shape solution recommendations, and deliver compelling proposals, quotes, and presentations that address customer requirements</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience managing complex sales cycles with large, strategic enterprise customers, selling into the Digital Natives and retail segment</li> <li>Proven ability to prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities while also growing existing accounts through strong account management</li> <li>Skill in leading pre- and post-sales activities, coordinating with technical, support, and channel partners to drive adoption and expansion</li> <li>Proficiency in consultative selling, including uncovering business needs, building account plans, and delivering proposals and presentations that align GitLab solutions to customer outcomes</li> <li>Ability to prepare and maintain accurate activity, pipeline, and forecast reports, and to contribute to win/loss and root cause analysis</li> title: Platform Engineer, Edge & Networking
description: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Edge & Networking squad. This team owns everything that happens at the network perimeter: API gateway, routing, load balancing, DNS, and secure global traffic distribution. You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly automated — enabling us to to scale reliably while maintaining low latency and high availability across our global infrastructure. You will work closely with other infrastructure and product teams to ensure seamless integration, observability, and performance of our edge services. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: - Help build and maintain the Supabase Cloud offering; - Design and implement Supabase’s global edge router platform; - Build programmable, API-driven routing logic to dynamically steer customer traffic; - Work with DNS, WAF, IP networking, TLS termination, CDN integrations, and global load balancing; - Implement advanced observability: relevant metric and log capturing, latency measurements, traffic shaping, routing health, and failure mitigation. - Optimize routing performance to minimize latency and improve reliability across cloud regions. - Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to integrate networking solutions into the entire Supabase stack; - Improve our system architecture to reduce costs while balancing security, reliability, and performance; - Design CI/CD systems to speed up deployments with proper change and release management processes; - Participate in on-call rotations, incident response, and post-incident reviews for edge-related issues; - Resolve escalated support issues, while also identifying and resolving systemic issues across the platform. YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU HAVE: - 5+ years experience in SRE/DevOps/Cloud Infrastructure; - 4+ years experience building and operating high-scale networking or edge infrastructure; - Strong experience with HTTP, TCP/IP, TLS certificate management, CDN internals, load balancing, and global routing; - Proficiency with traffic proxies / routers (e.g., Envoy, NGINX, HAProxy, Traefik, or building your own); - Experience designing systems for high availability, failover, and real-time observability; - Strong software engineering skills (Go); - Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across distributed systems; - Knowledge of IPv6, BGP, Anycast, or advanced routing protocols; - Experience in managing large deployments on AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar; - Comfortable with cloud networking primitives (AWS, GCP, Azure, or similar); - Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Pulumi preferred, Terraform/CDK etc also acceptable); - Experience with being part of on-call rotations for large production systems. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Junior Payroll Assistant
description: Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs. We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space. We operate across 3 business segments: Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific. Mission of the role To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines. The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation. Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls. Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month. Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission. Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements. Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy. Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries. Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day. Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required. Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues. Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times. Must-have experience Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience. Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred. Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage. Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes. Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage. Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information. Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics. Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows. Must-have attributes Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks. Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required. Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements. Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients. Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship. AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective. Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles: We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles: Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us. Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence. Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers. Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue. Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business. The interview process The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish. TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background. Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines. Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations. Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages. Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify: Your education Any criminal history Any political exposure Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com. Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦ Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region. Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional. Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy. title: Social Comms
description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public. You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work. You'd be a great fit if You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious. You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have. You've run or grown popular social accounts before. You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you. You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about. You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included. You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time. You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits. Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks. title: Field Marketer
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE: Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority. The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies. In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business. As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line. This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE: - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life. - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners. - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition. - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact. - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: - 4-5+ years of related marketing experience. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results. - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory. - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking. - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it. - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics. NICE TO HAVES: - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses - Salesforce, Marketo experience Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. products.</li><li>Cross-Functional Enablement: Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li></ul><h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2><ul><li>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions title: Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations</h3> <ul> <li>US</li> </ul> <p><strong>Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026.</strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>The Global GTM Strategy, Planning and Operations team at Cloudflare supports our high-growth Sales organization through scalable, AI supported GTM planning and operations. We focus on thoughtful planning of sales capacity, segmentation, territory carving, quota setting, and compensation design while ensuring clear rules of engagement for our Sales Team. Our goal is to establish a cohesive, consistent process framework that can support high growth, enable the Company's strategy, and accelerate Cloudflare's leadership in the developer and AI-native business segments.</p> <p>As the Senior Principal, Sales Compensation Design & Strategy, you will design and manage Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plans across all customer facing teams including Sales, Technical Sales, Partner Sales, and Customer Success & Experience, to ensure they are motivating, aligned with Cloudflare's strategy, and industry leading. This is a high visibility role with significant executive engagement, including leading C-level discussions with our CRO, CFO, CPO, and COO, and serving as the design authority on the Executive Compensation Steering Committee.</p> <p>You will architect new compensation metrics that reflect how Cloudflare monetizes a developer first, AI supportive business - including consumption, adoption, and platform attach - and ensure roles, territories, and quotas align with compensation plans to achieve our GTM objectives. You will establish a governance framework for efficient compensation planning and partner closely with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure effective implementation and accurate payouts. A strong understanding of SaaS bookings, monetization approaches, and consumption and adoption models is essential.</p> <p>The scope of executive influence, the architectural work required to support our developer/AI business model, and the AI-native transformation of the compensation design function make this seat fundamental to our GTM execution strategy. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>Executive Leadership & Design Authority</p> <ul> <li>Lead the Sales Compensation Design Process with the Executive Steering Committee, including CRO, CFO, and CPO level stakeholders.</li> <li>Drive C-level discussions on compensation philosophy, pay-for-performance outcomes, and strategic trade-offs; develop recommendation decks and own the narrative through approval.</li> <li>Architect new metrics that align seller incentives with Cloudflare's developer platform and AI product strategy (e.g., Workers consumption, AI Gateway adoption, platform attach, multi-product penetration).</li> <li>Create a 3-year roadmap for the Sales Compensation Design function.</li> </ul> <p>AI-Native Compensation Design</p> <ul> <li>Build the AI Compensation Design Framework and Application - an internal capability that uses AI to accelerate plan modeling, scenario simulation, payout forecasting, and what-if analysis across thousands of sellers and territories.</li> <li>Leverage AI to design high-quality SPIFFs and incentive structures, including generating candidate designs, simulating seller behavior, and stress-testing against historical data before launch.</li> <li>Track ROI of comp plans, SPIFFs, and incentive programs using AI-driven analytics - moving from lagging reporting to predictive measurement of plan effectiveness, seller behavior change, and revenue lift.</li> <li>Develop AI-powered pay-for-performance reporting that surfaces insights for executives, managers, and sellers in real time, replacing static quarterly reviews with continuous intelligence.</li> </ul> <p>Cross-Functional Execution</p> <ul> <li>Collaborate with GTM Strategy, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, and Product to ensure effective deployment of compensation plans and GTM strategy.</li> <li>Lead compensation enablement and change management for the global Sales team, including AI-assisted communications, FAQ generation, and plan-acceptance workflows.</li> <li>Design SPIFFs and incentive strategies that balance long-term strategic bets with short-term revenue goals.</li> <li>Partner with the Compensation Administration and Operations Teams to ensure design intent translates into accurate, auditable payouts.</li> </ul> <p>Required Experience & Skills</p> <ul> <li>15+ years of experience in Sales Compensation Design in a fast-paced tech company or as a management consultant.</li> <li>Demonstrated fluency with AI tools and AI-augmented workflows - whether through prior comp design work, analytics, or strategic projects. Comfort building or directing the build of AI-powered internal applications is strongly preferred.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including the ability to architect new metrics for emerging business models (consumption, AI monetization).</li> <li>Exceptional presentation and communication skills, with proven experience presenting to and influencing C-level executives.</li> <li>Proven experience driving Executive Steering Committee meetings and owning the decision narrative end-to-end.</li> <li>Experience leading cross-functional initiatives to completion across Finance, HR, IT, Product, and GTM.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with a strategic mindset.</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate combines a strong background in sales strategy and compensation design with genuine curiosity about applying AI to transform the function. Candidates will have exceptional stakeholder management skills, executive presence, and the confidence to manage evolving strategies in a high-growth company. </p> <h3>Compensation</h3> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $230,000 - $317,000</li> <li>For California (excluding Bay Area), Washington, Washington DC, NY and NJ based hires: $220,000 - $303,000</li> <li>For Colorado based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $275,000</li> </ul> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p>Health & Welfare Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p>Financial Benefits</p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p>Time Off</p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever.

title: Brand Designer, Creative Studio
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE This role is based in New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. This role sits on Notion’s Creative Studio, a small team of designers, illustrators, and filmmakers. Our work tells the story of our offering in a way that reflects the products themselves: smart, refined, and with a dash of wit on the side. As a Brand Designer, you’ll work on high-impact brand initiatives and campaigns: setting direction from early strategy through final execution, partnering closely with stakeholders and executives, and raising the bar for craft and systems. You’ll be asked to define approaches, resolve ambiguity, and influence both project outcomes and how the team works. WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE - Concept, art direct and design high-visibility moments from brand campaigns, product launches, and events, developing approaches that can scale across a broad range of surfaces, moments, and channels. - Contribute to our brand systems and develop standards and tooling that improve velocity and consistency for teammates near and far. - Mentor and raise the bar for other designers and creative partners through feedback, critique, and patterns that make great work repeatable. SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING - 10+ years in an agency or in-house environment, with demonstrated leadership on ambiguous, complex, high-impact work. - A strong portfolio of work that’s culturally resonant and visually diverse, and that showcases your ability to tell stories across many channels. - A deep commitment to systems thinking, typographic excellence, and sensitivity to small details. - Experience working with a broad range of makers. You’ve teamed up with illustrators, animators, copywriters, filmmakers, photographers, and beyond to bring your ideas to life. - Excellent partnership skills. You can work hand-in-hand with cross-functional stakeholders, drive alignment, and make pragmatic tradeoffs. - A tinkerer’s mindset. You're curious about how your tools are evolving and have a strong perspective on how AI can expand creative expression and drive production. You’ll actively experiment with new AI workflows to concept, prototype, and push our design systems further. Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $250,000 per year. By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. title: Partner Operations & Systems Lead
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE Supabase's Partnerships function is scaling fast - spanning Technology Partners, Solution Partners, Startups, and Cloud Partnerships. We're looking for a Partner Operations & Systems Lead to own the operational and technical backbone that lets this team move quickly and make decisions with good data. This is a senior, hands-on role. You'll design the systems, processes, and reporting that the whole partnerships org runs on - and, increasingly, you'll build the internal tools yourself. Supabase is investing heavily in AI-assisted development to move faster than a traditional ops build cycle allows, and this role is expected to be a leading example of that inside Partnerships. You'll report directly to the Head of Partnerships and sit alongside our regional and functional leads as a peer, with the mandate to build and enforce operational rigor across all teams. Beyond the infrastructure, we want someone who helps shape where Partnerships places its bets - not just the system that reports on them. WHAT YOU'LL OWN Systems & Data Infrastructure - Own the partner tech stack end-to-end - CRM partner objects, attribution tooling, and partner-facing portals. - Design and maintain partner attribution models and the dashboards leadership uses to evaluate performance. - Ensure data hygiene and consistency across partner records, deals, and touchpoints spanning all sub-functions. Process & Program Management - Design and run partner onboarding, tiering, and certification programs. - Own the RFC / DRI decision-making framework for the partnerships team, including how it's used and refined over time. - Run deal-registration and "quarterback" account-ownership processes that keep internal teams aligned on partner-sourced deals. - Build and maintain the playbooks, SOPs, and enablement materials that let the team scale without you in every meeting. Internal Tooling & Automation - Build internal automations that remove manual ops work - e.g., auto-generated partner performance reports, HubSpot-to-Slack syncs, or deal-conflict alerts - using AI-assisted development tools like Claude Code. - Prototype and ship lightweight internal apps and dashboards (partner health scorecards, RFC trackers, cross-tool syncs) without waiting on a shared data engineering backlog. - Act as technical owner for partnerships' internal tools: write the spec, build it, test it, ship it, and maintain it. - Know where the line is between a quick internal script and something that needs to be handed to Data/Engineering for production hardening - and manage that handoff cleanly. Reporting & Analytics - Produce recurring performance reporting on partner-attributed revenue and pipeline influence. - Own the metrics and KPI framework the partnerships team is measured against. - Support QBRs and board-level reporting on partnership performance. Strategic Contribution - Contribute to partner segmentation, tiering, and prioritization strategy - bringing data and operational reality to bear on where the team should invest. - Challenge existing assumptions in the partner motion (which tiers, which incentive structures, which sub-functions get resourced) using evidence from the systems you own. - Partner with the Head of Partnerships on strategic planning cycles - translating operational signal into recommendations, not just dashboards. - Own execution of agreed strategic direction: once a call is made, drive the operational and cross-functional work to make it real. Cross-Functional Leadership - Serve as the connective tissue between Partnerships, Sales, RevOps, Legal, and Finance. - Ensure partner agreement terms are correctly reflected in systems and reporting. - Sit at the table for partner segmentation, tiering, and incentive-structure decisions as a contributor and challenger, not just an operator reporting on them after the fact. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 7+ years in partner operations, revenue operations, or a related ops function, including experience designing (not just running) a program at scale. - Proven ownership of a partner or revenue tech stack - you've made the build/buy/migrate calls, not just administered someone else's setup. - Comfortable operating as the operational voice in exec-level rooms - QBRs, board prep, and cross-functional planning. - Hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development (Claude Code or similar) - you can scope a problem, prompt effectively, review the output critically, and ship something real. - A point of view on partner economics - rev share modeling, LTV by partner type - that can inform deal structuring, not just track it after signature. - A track record of shaping strategic decisions, not just implementing them - comfortable pressure-testing a plan in the room and then owning the execution once direction is set. - Experience managing a small team or dotted-line relationships across regions or sub-functions. - Excellent written communication - you can turn ambiguity into a clear framework or a one-page decision doc. NICE TO HAVE - Experience with HubSpot (custom partner objects, multi-touch attribution), Clazar for cloud co-sell, and Linear for project management. - Background in a developer-tools or platform business with a partner-driven go-to-market motion. - Prior experience building internal tools or scripts, even informally, before AI-assisted development made it mainstream. HOW WE'LL EVALUATE Alongside standard interviews, candidates will complete a short build exercise: given a messy partner-data problem, show us how you'd use Claude Code (or a similar tool) to solve it. We're evaluating judgment and problem-scoping as much as the output itself. WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Software Engineer - Branching
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We’re building a high-performance CI/CD execution platform similar to runners used by tools like Buildkite, GitHub Actions, and Blacksmith CI. Our platform executes developer pipelines reliably at scale, integrates deeply with source control, and automates build, test, and deployment workflows. In this role, you will design and build the distributed systems responsible for running CI/CD pipelines securely and efficiently. This includes orchestrating ephemeral compute environments, managing build isolation, scheduling jobs across fleets of workers, and ensuring reliability at scale. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions. WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Design and improve the core orchestration engine that manages the lifecycle of creating, merging, and rebasing Supabase Branches https://supabase.com/docs/guides/deployment/branching. - Provision ephemeral sandboxed execution environment on EKS / ECS for running untrusted build workloads from connected git repositories with securely managed secrets. - Implement job scheduling that scale to thousands of concurrent builds. - Optimize and reduce pipeline runtimes with caching, artifact storage, and dependency reuse. - Manage retry, timeout, cancellation, and failure-propagation logic to ensure pipelines behave predictably under failure conditions. - Instrument the full pipeline lifecycle with observability tooling to surface traces, metrics, and structured logs to the end user. - Develop configuration files (JSON / TOML) and integrations (Terraform / Pulumi) that allow teams to easily define, trigger, and inspect pipelines in code. YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have strong software engineering skills (Go and Typescript required); - Have 3+ years of experience building and operating cloud infrastructure or distributed systems at scale; - Have cloud Infrastructure knowledge - familiarity with AWS constructs is required, past experience using the AWS SDKs and IaC tools (Pulumi, Terraform, etc) to build and operate infrastructure is strongly preferred. - Have a production operations mindset - track record of building reliable, observable, and maintainable systems - Have an ownership mindset - you thrive in being able to operate independently with high-level guidance - Communicate clearly across both technical and non-technical audiences - Have experience in async or globally distributed teams - Are energized by solving real-world problems for developers - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity and moving quickly WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

title: Platform Engineer - Compute Capacity
description: ABOUT SUPABASE Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a platform engineer to join our Compute Capacity team. This team owns the capacity plan that keeps compute supply ahead of demand across every region we operate in — the forecasting, buffer policy, and provisioning systems that make sure a project never runs into a wall it didn't know was there. You'll work on the systems that turn a capacity plan into provisioned reality: reservation acquisition, fleet reconciliation, and the automation that keeps what we've committed to in sync with what we're actually running. You'll help build the metrics and alerting that let capacity problems surface months out, on vendor lead time, rather than at the moment someone needs the room. You'll design, build, and operate systems that are both robust and highly automated — helping us hold the right buffer at the right cost, catch drift before it becomes a shortage, and give every team a single, trustworthy view of how much room we have across the millions of databases we manage. WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR - Help build and maintain the capacity plan that keeps Supabase's compute supply ahead of demand across regions and instance families - Support buffer policy by modeling headroom targets and their cost tradeoffs for review and sign-off - Build and maintain automation that turns the capacity plan into provisioned reality — reservation acquisition and top-up, fleet reconciliation, drift detection between committed and running capacity - Extend our infrastructure as code for capacity-relevant provisioning - Instrument capacity: build and maintain metrics for saturation, reservation coverage, idle buffer, forecast error, and provisioning latency - Build and tune capacity alerting so headroom, quota, and reservation issues surface months out rather than at the moment of impact - Support the demand gate — helping intake large customer commitments, launches, migrations, and new regions so they reach the plan before they reach the fleet - Contribute to mitigation projects: right-sizing, instance-family migrations, autoscaling improvements, workload consolidation - Help drive down compute cost per database through right-sizing, placement, and commitment coverage work - Participate in capacity incident response and post-incident follow-through YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU - Have 5+ years across infrastructure engineering, SRE, platform, or capacity engineering, ideally at SaaS or cloud infrastructure scale - Have production software engineering experience — you've owned and operated a service, not just a notebook. Comfortable in modern languages like TypeScript, Python, and Go - Are comfortable working against forecasts and assumptions that are incomplete, and can revise your work as those assumptions change - Have experience with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform) - Have built or maintained observability for systems you own — metrics that answer real questions and alerting people trust (Prometheus/Grafana, CloudWatch, or similar); - Have solid working knowledge of AWS EC2: instance families and generations, purchase options, capacity reservations, and quota mechanics - Have some financial fluency — you understand reservation economics and the basic tradeoffs between coverage, utilization, and cost - Communicate clearly across audiences, from engineers to finance stakeholders WHAT WE OFFER - Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. - ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. - Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. - Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. - Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. - Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. - Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. ABOUT THE TEAM Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. - ~400 team members - 60+ countries - 20+ languages spoken - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) - 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. title: Outcomes Architect Manager, Tokyo
description: WHO WE ARE Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work. ABOUT THE ROLE Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them. This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes. You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness. If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion. - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes. - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership. - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met. - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals. - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value. - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion. - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs. SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy. - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation. - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it. - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account. - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans. - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams. - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team. - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity. - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership. - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers. - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems. - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes. NICE TO HAVES - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes. - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management. - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership. - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path. - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model. - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software. A NOTE ON AI You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on. EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
